articles.title: Saudi strikes on Yemen buses and trucks leave 25 dead or missing: Report
articles.summary: Saudi strikes on Yemen buses and trucks leave 25 dead or missing: Report Saudi aircraft struck buses and trucks in Wadi Maabaq in Yemen’s Lahj governorate, leaving 25 people dead or missing and wounding six, the Saba news agency reports. Residents told Saba that badly burnt remains were still inside one of two buses hit in the attack, hampering identification. They said Saudi warplanes continued circling overhead, blocking ambulance crews and residents from reaching those caught in the strikes and worsening the toll.

articles.title: Red Crescent evacuates 26 Palestinian patients from Gaza for treatment
articles.summary: Red Crescent evacuates 26 Palestinian patients from Gaza for treatment The Palestine Red Crescent Society transferred 26 patients out of Gaza this morning to receive medical care, with 27 companions accompanying them, Wafa reports. Before departure, medics provided care at the al-Mawasi field hospital. The Red Crescent arranged the evacuation with the World Health Organization, according to the Palestinian news agency. Local medical sources say injuries among Palestinians have exceeded 6,000 since the so-called “ceasefire” began in Gaza.
